WITH lead_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 'high') AS high_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 'medium') AS medium_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 'low') AS low_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_leads
  FROM leads
),
invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'valid') AS valid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'suspicious') AS suspicious_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'invalid') AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_invoices
  FROM invoices
),
recent_errors AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS error_count
  FROM error_logs
  WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'leads', (SELECT row_to_json(lead_stats) FROM lead_stats),
  'invoices', (SELECT row_to_json(invoice_stats) FROM invoice_stats),
  'errors_last_24h', (SELECT error_count FROM recent_errors),
  'generated_at', NOW()
) AS summary;
